TI.P: Corrigendum to Directive 2008/48/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 April 2008 on credit agreements for consumers and repealing Council Directive 87/102/EEC
(Official Journal of the European Union L 133 of 22 May 2008)

DESCRIPTION.P: The Corrigendum which was published in the Official Journal of the European Union L 199 of 31 July 2010, p. 40, shall be cancelled and replaced with regard to the following item:
